detail.body:
## Overview

Adds an `ISLAND` all-reduce backend for a TP group of 8 on ROCm nodes whose GPUs form two fully connected 4-GPU XGMI
islands joined only by PCIe (8x MI210). Today such a group uses RCCL's flat ring for every all-reduce, because the custom
all-reduce needs full connectivity and is enabled on MI300+ only.

## Claims

- On 8x MI210, TP=8, `Qwen/Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct`: decode TPOT p50 −12.5% at 1 user, −23% at 8 users, −18% at 16 users;
  TTFT for a 3,000-token prompt −18%; output throughput +14% to +29%.
- Per all-reduce it is 1.1–2.4x faster than `PyNcclCommunicator` up to 1.5 MB and 1.4–1.9x from 2.25 MB to 48 MB.
- No new kernels: it composes `CustomAllreduce` and `PyNcclCommunicator`.
- Active only on ROCm, TP=8, two-island topology, when neither the flat custom all-reduce nor AITER is in use; everything
  else keeps its current backend. `VLLM_ROCM_ISLAND_ALLREDUCE=0` turns it off.

## Validation

Hardware: one node with 8x MI210 (gfx90a), ROCm 7.2.3, RCCL 2.27.7. Software: the nightly ROCm image at `2eb491e` with
the four changed Python files of this PR mounted over the installed package.

**End to end**, backend on vs off (off = PyNccl only). `vllm serve Qwen/Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct --tensor-parallel-size 8
--max-num-seqs 16 --max-model-len 8192`, with `VLLM_ROCM_ISLAND_ALLREDUCE=1` or `0`; load from
`vllm bench serve --dataset-name random --ignore-eos --temperature 0 --request-rate inf` (decode: 128 tokens in / 256
out; prefill: 3,000 in / 32 out). Four server boots in A-B-B-A order; each cell is the mean of the two boots of that
arm, which agree within 0.5% on TPOT. No request failed.

| Workload | TPOT p50 off → on | TTFT p50 off → on | Output throughput |
|---|---|---|---|
| decode, 1 user | 26.7 → 23.3 ms (−12.5%) | 93 → 85 ms (−9%) | 37.2 → 42.5 tok/s (+14%) |
| decode, 8 users | 53.2 → 41.0 ms (−22.9%) | 324 → 271 ms (−17%) | 147 → 190 tok/s (+29%) |
| decode, 16 users | 53.9 → 44.1 ms (−18.1%) | 267 → 218 ms (−19%) | 287 → 351 tok/s (+22%) |
| prefill 3k, 1 user | 26.8 → 23.4 ms (−12.5%) | 1,099 → 905 ms (−18%) | 19.0 → 22.3 tok/s (+18%) |
| prefill 3k, 8 users | 168.6 → 137.6 ms (−18.4%) | 2,560 → 2,084 ms (−19%) | 34.3 → 42.2 tok/s (+23%) |

**Outputs.** Greedy completions for 16 fixed chat prompts (96 tokens): an on boot and an off boot give identical text
for 10–12 of 16 prompts; two boots of the same arm give identical text for 10 of 16 (on vs on, and off vs off). The
backend adds no divergence beyond the boot-to-boot variation of this setup. I did not run an accuracy benchmark.

**Per all-reduce**, `tokens x 6144` bf16 through the TP group against the group's `PyNcclCommunicator` (50 calls per
size, mean over the 8 ranks):

| Tokens | Bytes | Path | Island | PyNccl | Speedup |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 12 KB | custom | 37 µs | 39 µs | 1.1x |
| 2–8 | 24–98 KB | custom | 32 µs | 76–77 µs | 2.4x |
| 16 | 197 KB | custom | 40 µs | 78 µs | 2.0x |
| 64 | 786 KB | custom | 79 µs | 101 µs | 1.3x |
| 128 | 1.5 MB | custom | 139 µs | 149 µs | 1.07x |
| 192 | 2.25 MB | hierarchical | 145 µs | 202 µs | 1.39x |
| 256 | 3 MB | hierarchical | 173 µs | 241 µs | 1.39x |
| 1,024 | 12 MB | hierarchical | 471 µs | 827 µs | 1.76x |
| 4,096 | 48 MB | hierarchical | 1,716 µs | 3,215 µs | 1.87x |

**Tests.** `pytest tests/distributed/test_island_all_reduce.py`: 12 passed on the MI210 node. They cover the sum
against an fp32 reference on both paths (bf16, fp16), the declined sizes, the custom path switched off, CUDA-graph
capture and replay through the TP group's `graph_capture()`, and the topology detection (needs no GPU).
`tests/distributed/test_custom_all_reduce.py` and `tests/distributed/test_pynccl.py` give the same result with and
without this change on that node (70 passed, 1 skipped, and `test_custom_allreduce[test_target1-2-2]` fails in both;
see Details).

**Sync check.** A server boot with `VLLM_GPU_SYNC_CHECK=error` and the backend on served a decode and a prefill
workload without a failure.

**CI gap.** AMD CI has no MI200 runners, so the GPU tests skip there (they need 8 ROCm GPUs in two islands); only the
topology-detection test runs. The numbers above are the validation for the hardware path.

## Details

- **Small tensors (< 2.25 MiB, also in CUDA graphs):** `CustomAllreduce` inside each 4-GPU island, then across the GPU
  pair at the same island position (a 2-GPU group, which `CustomAllreduce` already allows without full connectivity).
- **Large tensors (>= 2.25 MiB, eager only):** `PyNcclCommunicator` reduce-scatter inside the island, all-reduce of the
  quarter-size shard across the four pairs, all-gather inside the island. A quarter of the data crosses PCIe, on four
  links in parallel.
- Other inputs (size not a multiple of 16 bytes below the large threshold, non-contiguous, large tensors during graph
  capture) return to the existing dispatch chain.
- **Thresholds.** In a tight loop the hierarchical path overtakes the custom path at about 1 MiB. In a running server
  the break-even is about 2.25 MiB: with both thresholds at 1 MiB, TTFT for 96–160-token prompts was 3–9% worse than
  with 3 MiB (measured on our v0.25.1-based fork, A-B-B-A). Both default to 2.25 MiB and are tunable
  (`VLLM_ROCM_ISLAND_AR_CUSTOM_MAX_BYTES`, `VLLM_ROCM_ISLAND_AR_HIER_MIN_BYTES`).
- **Copy-in path only.** The custom kernels are called with `registered=False`, also inside graphs. On MI210 with
  ROCm 7 the registered-graph-buffer mode returns wrong sums; that is the pre-existing failure of
  `test_custom_allreduce[test_target1-2-2]` on this node.
- **Batch invariance.** The algorithm depends on tensor size, so the backend is off under `VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT`
  (documented in `docs/features/batch_invariance.md`).
- **Limitations.** TP=8 on this topology only. Tested on MI210 only. A standard 4-module MI250 node is fully
  XGMI-connected (every GPU pair is one hop), so the backend does not activate there. Thresholds come from one node type. On our nodes, running the large path at the
  same time as GPU-direct RDMA writes out of the same GPUs (a KV-transfer connector that registers GPU memory with the
  NICs) hard-reset the machine; this looks like a platform issue outside vLLM and is the reason the large path has its
  own switch.
- **Not a duplicate.** I searched open and closed PRs and issues for MI200/MI210/MI250, "island" and two-level
  all-reduce and found none. Related: #19744 (QuickReduce), #46065 (AITER custom all-reduce), both MI300-class.

**Questions for maintainers**

1. Default on for the detected topology, or opt-in?
2. AMD CI has no MI200 runners. Is the GPU-free topology test plus the logs from our MI210 node enough, or do you want
   something else?
3. Any preference on where the backend sits in the dispatch order? It runs after AITER and before `CUSTOM`, and only
   when neither of those is active.

---

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+
+import multiprocessing as mp
+import os
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+
+from vllm.distributed.communication_op import tensor_model_parallel_all_reduce
+from vllm.distributed.device_communicators.island_all_reduce import (
+    is_two_island_topology,
+)
+from vllm.distributed.parallel_state import get_tp_group, graph_capture
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+from vllm.utils.network_utils import get_open_port
+
+from ..utils import init_test_distributed_environment
+
+WORLD_SIZE = 8
+HIDDEN = 6144
+# Exit code of a worker whose GPUs are not two 4-GPU XGMI islands.
+NOT_TWO_ISLANDS = 77
+
+
+def _fully_connected_within_islands(ids: list[int]) -> bool:
+    return len({i // 4 for i in ids}) == 1
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "ids,connected,expected",
+    [
+        (list(range(8)), _fully_connected_within_islands, True),
+        # A fully connected node (e.g. 8x MI300X) uses the flat custom all-reduce.
+        (list(range(8)), lambda ids: True, False),
+        # PCIe-only GPUs have no islands.
+        (list(range(8)), lambda ids: len(ids) == 1, False),
+        (list(range(4)), _fully_connected_within_islands, False),
+        # The TP rank order must follow the islands.
+        ([0, 4, 1, 5, 2, 6, 3, 7], _fully_connected_within_islands, False),
+    ],
+)
+def test_two_island_topology_detection(ids, connected, expected):
+    with patch.object(
+        current_platform, "is_fully_connected", side_effect=connected, create=True
+    ):
+        assert is_two_island_topology(ids) is expected
+
+
+def _rank_input(rank: int, tokens: int, dtype: torch.dtype, seed: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+    g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(1000 * seed + rank)
+    return (torch.randn(tokens, HIDDEN, generator=g) * (1 + rank)).to(dtype)
+
+
+def _check(out: torch.Tensor | None, tokens: int, dtype: torch.dtype, seed: int):
+    assert out is not None
+    parts = [_rank_input(r, tokens, dtype, seed).float() for r in range(WORLD_SIZE)]
+    ref = torch.stack(parts).sum(0).to(out.device)
+    err = (out.float() - ref).abs().max() / ref.abs().max()
+    assert err < 2e-2, f"tokens={tokens} rel err {err.item():.2e}"
+
+
+def _island_worker(rank: int, port: int, case: str, dtype_name: str) -> None:
+    if case == "custom_off":
+        os.environ["VLLM_ROCM_ISLAND_AR_CUSTOM_MAX_BYTES"] = "0"
+    from vllm.distributed.device_communicators.island_all_reduce import (
+        IslandAllReduce,
+    )
+
+    device = torch.device(f"cuda:{rank}")
+    torch.accelerator.set_device_index(device)
+    dist.init_process_group(
+        backend="gloo",
+        init_method=f"tcp://127.0.0.1:{port}",
+        rank=rank,
+        world_size=WORLD_SIZE,
+    )
+    iar = IslandAllReduce(dist.group.WORLD, device, list(range(WORLD_SIZE)))
+    if iar.disabled:
+        raise SystemExit(NOT_TWO_ISLANDS)
+    dtype = getattr(torch, dtype_name)
+
+    def check(out: torch.Tensor | None, tokens: int) -> None:
+        _check(out, tokens, dtype, 0)
+
+    try:
+        if case == "small":
+            assert iar.ca_island is not None
+            for tokens in (1, 3, 64):
+                check(
+                    iar.all_reduce(_rank_input(rank, tokens, dtype, 0).to(device)),
+                    tokens,
+                )
+        elif case == "large":
+            assert iar.hierarchical
+            for tokens in (256, 1024, 4096):
+                check(
+                    iar.all_reduce(_rank_input(rank, tokens, dtype, 0).to(device)),
+                    tokens,
+                )
+        elif case == "custom_off":
+            assert iar.ca_island is None and iar.hierarchical
+            check(iar.all_reduce(_rank_input(rank, 256, dtype, 0).to(device)), 256)
+            assert (
+                iar.all_reduce(torch.ones(8, HIDDEN, dtype=dtype, device=device))
+                is None
+            )
+        elif case == "declined":
+            # 8194 bytes: not a 16-byte multiple and below the hierarchical
+            # threshold, so the caller must fall back.
+            odd = torch.ones(4097, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=device)
+            assert iar.all_reduce(odd) is None
+        else:
+            raise ValueError(case)
+    finally:
+        iar.destroy()
+        dist.destroy_process_group()
+
+
+def _tp_group_worker(rank: int, port: int) -> None:
+    """Backend selection, dispatch and graph capture through the TP group."""
+    device = torch.device(f"cuda:{rank}")
+    torch.accelerator.set_device_index(device)
+    init_test_distributed_environment(WORLD_SIZE, 1, rank, str(port))
+    iar = get_tp_group().device_communicator.island_ar_comm
+    if iar is None or iar.disabled:
+        raise SystemExit(NOT_TWO_ISLANDS)
+    tokens, dtype = 8, torch.bfloat16
+    static = _rank_input(rank, tokens, dtype, 0).to(device)
+    tensor_model_parallel_all_reduce(static)
+    torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+    graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+    with (
+        graph_capture(device=device) as capture_context,
+        torch.cuda.graph(graph, stream=capture_context.stream),
+    ):
+        graph_out = tensor_model_parallel_all_reduce(static)
+    for seed in range(1, 6):
+        new = _rank_input(rank, tokens, dtype, seed).to(device)
+        static.copy_(new)
+        graph.replay()
+        torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+        _check(graph_out, tokens, dtype, seed)
+        # Same kernels in the same order, eager and replayed.
+        assert torch.equal(iar.all_reduce(new), graph_out)
+
+
+def _run_workers(target, *args) -> None:
+    ctx = mp.get_context("spawn")
+    port = get_open_port()
+    procs = [
+        ctx.Process(target=target, args=(rank, port, *args))
+        for rank in range(WORLD_SIZE)
+    ]
+    for proc in procs:
+        proc.start()
+    for proc in procs:
+        proc.join(timeout=300)
+    codes = [proc.exitcode for proc in procs]
+    if all(code == NOT_TWO_ISLANDS for code in codes):
+        pytest.skip("GPUs are not two 4-GPU XGMI islands")
+    assert codes == [0] * WORLD_SIZE, f"worker exit codes: {codes}"
+
+
+requires_8_rocm_gpus = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not current_platform.is_rocm() or current_platform.device_count() < WORLD_SIZE,
+    reason="requires 8 ROCm GPUs",
+)
+
+
+@requires_8_rocm_gpus
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("dtype_name", ["bfloat16", "float16"])
+def test_island_all_reduce_small_tensors_match_fp32_sum(dtype_name):
+    _run_workers(_island_worker, "small", dtype_name)
+
+
+@requires_8_rocm_gpus
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("dtype_name", ["bfloat16", "float16"])
+def test_island_all_reduce_large_tensors_match_fp32_sum(dtype_name):
+    _run_workers(_island_worker, "large", dtype_name)
+
+
+@requires_8_rocm_gpus
+def test_island_all_reduce_declines_unsupported_size():
+    _run_workers(_island_worker, "declined", "bfloat16")
+
+
+@requires_8_rocm_gpus
+def test_island_all_reduce_tp_group_cudagraph_replay_matches_eager():
+    _run_workers(_tp_group_worker)
+
+
+@requires_8_rocm_gpus
+def test_island_all_reduce_custom_path_disabled_by_zero_limit():
+    _run_workers(_island_worker, "custom_off", "bfloat16")

@@ -0,0 +1,176 @@
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Two-level all-reduce for a TP group spanning two XGMI islands (ROCm).
+
+Targets nodes whose 8 GPUs form two fully connected 4-GPU XGMI islands joined
+only by PCIe (e.g. 8x MI210). There the flat custom all-reduce is unavailable
+(the group is not fully connected) and a flat RCCL ring crosses PCIe twice per
+step. Instead:
+
+* large tensors (eager only): RCCL reduce-scatter inside the island, all-reduce
+  of the quarter-size shard across the pairs, all-gather inside the island;
+* smaller tensors, and CUDA graphs: vLLM's custom all-reduce inside each
+  island, then across the GPU pair at the same island position.
+
+The custom kernels always copy the input into the pre-registered IPC buffer,
+also inside CUDA graphs: registered graph buffers return wrong sums on MI210
+with ROCm 7.
+"""
+
+from contextlib import ExitStack, contextmanager
+
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+from torch.distributed import ProcessGroup
+
+import vllm.envs as envs
+from vllm.logger import init_logger
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+logger = init_logger(__name__)
+
+_ISLAND_WORLD_SIZE = 8
+
+
+def is_two_island_topology(physical_device_ids: list[int]) -> bool:
+    """Whether the GPUs split into two fully connected halves that are not
+    fully connected to each other."""
+    half = len(physical_device_ids) // 2
+    return (
+        len(physical_device_ids) == _ISLAND_WORLD_SIZE
+        and not current_platform.is_fully_connected(physical_device_ids)
+        and current_platform.is_fully_connected(physical_device_ids[:half])
+        and current_platform.is_fully_connected(physical_device_ids[half:])
+    )
+
+
+class IslandAllReduce:
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        cpu_group: ProcessGroup,
+        device: torch.device,
+        global_ranks: list[int],
+    ):
+        from vllm.distributed.device_communicators.custom_all_reduce import (
+            CustomAllreduce,
+        )
+        from vllm.distributed.device_communicators.pynccl import PyNcclCommunicator
+
+        self.disabled = True
+        self.ca_island: CustomAllreduce | None = None
+        self.ca_pair: CustomAllreduce | None = None
+        world_size = dist.get_world_size(cpu_group)
+        # dist.new_group below must be called by every process of the job.
+        if (
+            not current_platform.is_rocm()
+            or world_size != _ISLAND_WORLD_SIZE
+            or world_size != dist.get_world_size()
+        ):
+            return
+
+        assert device.index is not None
+        phys = torch.tensor(
+            [current_platform.visible_device_id_to_physical_device_id(device.index)],
+            dtype=torch.int,
+        )
+        gathered = [torch.zeros_like(phys) for _ in range(world_size)]
+        dist.all_gather(gathered, phys, group=cpu_group)
+        ids = [int(t.item()) for t in gathered]
+        if not is_two_island_topology(ids):
+            return
+
+        half = world_size // 2
+        r = global_ranks
+        islands = [
+            dist.new_group(r[:half], backend="gloo"),
+            dist.new_group(r[half:], backend="gloo"),
+        ]
+        pairs = [
+            dist.new_group([r[i], r[i + half]], backend="gloo") for i in range(half)
+        ]
+        me = dist.get_rank(cpu_group)
+        island, pair = islands[me // half], pairs[me % half]
+
+        self.max_custom_bytes = envs.VLLM_ROCM_ISLAND_AR_CUSTOM_MAX_BYTES
+        self.min_hier_bytes = envs.VLLM_ROCM_ISLAND_AR_HIER_MIN_BYTES
+        # A zero limit turns the custom path off; CustomAllreduce cannot
+        # allocate an empty shared buffer.
+        if self.max_custom_bytes > 0:
+            ca_island, ca_pair = (
+                CustomAllreduce(
+                    group,
+                    device,
+                    max_size=self.max_custom_bytes,
+                    max_all_gather_size=self.max_custom_bytes,
+                    max_reduce_scatter_size=self.max_custom_bytes,
+                )
+                for group in (island, pair)
+            )
+            if not (ca_island.disabled or ca_pair.disabled):
+                self.ca_island, self.ca_pair = ca_island, ca_pair
+        # PyNccl rather than torch NCCL process groups: their watchdog queries
+        # events, which HIP forbids during graph capture.
+        self.nccl_island = PyNcclCommunicator(island, device)
+        self.nccl_pair = PyNcclCommunicator(pair, device)
+        self.hierarchical = not (self.nccl_island.disabled or self.nccl_pair.disabled)
+        if self.ca_island is None and not self.hierarchical:
+            return
+        self.disabled = False
+        logger.info_once(
+            "Island all-reduce enabled for GPUs %s: two-level custom < %d B (%s), "
+            "hierarchical RCCL >= %d B (%s).",
+            str(ids),
+            self.max_custom_bytes,
+            "on" if self.ca_island is not None else "off",
+            self.min_hier_bytes,
+            "on" if self.hierarchical else "off",
+            scope="global",
+        )
+
+    def all_reduce(self, input_: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor | None:
+        """Returns None when the caller should use its default path."""
+        if self.disabled:
+            return None
+        nbytes = input_.numel() * input_.element_size()
+        if (
+            self.hierarchical
+            and nbytes >= self.min_hier_bytes
+            and input_.numel() % 4 == 0
+            and input_.is_contiguous()
+            and not torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing()
+        ):
+            flat = input_.view(-1)
+            shard = torch.empty(
+                flat.numel() // 4, dtype=input_.dtype, device=input_.device
+            )
+            self.nccl_island.reduce_scatter(shard, flat)
+            self.nccl_pair.all_reduce(shard, shard)
+            out = torch.empty_like(input_)
+            self.nccl_island.all_gather(out.view(-1), shard)
+            return out
+        if (
+            self.ca_island is not None
+            and self.ca_pair is not None
+            and nbytes < self.max_custom_bytes
+            and self.ca_island.should_custom_ar(input_)
+        ):
+            out = self.ca_island.all_reduce(input_, registered=False)
+            return self.ca_pair.all_reduce(out, registered=False)
+        return None
+
+    @contextmanager
+    def capture(self):
+        """Exchange the custom kernels' graph buffer addresses after capture."""
+        with ExitStack() as stack:
+            if self.ca_island is not None and self.ca_pair is not None:
+                stack.enter_context(self.ca_island.capture())
+                stack.enter_context(self.ca_pair.capture())
+            yield
+
+    def destroy(self):
+        if self.disabled:
+            return
+        self.nccl_island.destroy()
+        self.nccl_pair.destroy()
+        self.ca_island = self.ca_pair = None
+        self.disabled = True

@@ -682,6 +682,7 @@ def graph_capture(self, graph_capture_context: GraphCaptureContext | None = None
         maybe_ca_context = nullcontext()
         maybe_fi_pcie_ipc_context: AbstractContextManager[Any] = nullcontext()
         maybe_aiter_ar_context = nullcontext()
+        maybe_island_ar_context: AbstractContextManager[Any] = nullcontext()
         from vllm.distributed.device_communicators.cuda_communicator import (
             CudaCommunicator,
         )
@@ -701,6 +702,9 @@ def graph_capture(self, graph_capture_context: GraphCaptureContext | None = None
                 fi_pcie_ipc_ar_comm = self.device_communicator.fi_pcie_ipc_ar_comm
                 if fi_pcie_ipc_ar_comm is not None:
                     maybe_fi_pcie_ipc_context = fi_pcie_ipc_ar_comm.capture()
+                island_ar_comm = self.device_communicator.island_ar_comm
+                if island_ar_comm is not None and not island_ar_comm.disabled:
+                    maybe_island_ar_context = island_ar_comm.capture()
 
             # Capture each group's own comm. A global lookup would double-capture
             aiter_ar_comm = getattr(self.device_communicator, "aiter_ar_comm", None)
@@ -718,6 +722,7 @@ def graph_capture(self, graph_capture_context: GraphCaptureContext | None = None
             maybe_ca_context,
             maybe_fi_pcie_ipc_context,
             maybe_aiter_ar_context,
+            maybe_island_ar_context,
         ):
             yield graph_capture_context

@@ -264,6 +264,9 @@
     VLLM_ROCM_QUICK_REDUCE_MAX_SIZE_BYTES_MB: int | None = None
     VLLM_ROCM_QUICK_REDUCE_MIN_SIZE_BYTES_MB: int | None = None
     VLLM_ROCM_QUICK_REDUCE_QUANTIZATION_MIN_SIZE_KB: int | None = None
+    VLLM_ROCM_ISLAND_ALLREDUCE: bool = True
+    VLLM_ROCM_ISLAND_AR_CUSTOM_MAX_BYTES: int = 2304 * 1024
+    VLLM_ROCM_ISLAND_AR_HIER_MIN_BYTES: int = 2304 * 1024
     VLLM_MOONCAKE_ABORT_REQUEST_TIMEOUT: int = 480
     VLLM_MOONCAKE_CONNECTOR_TIMEOUT: float = 30.0
     VLLM_ENABLE_CUDAGRAPH_GC: bool = False
@@ -1430,6 +1433,21 @@ def _resolve_rust_cli_path() -> str | None:
         os.getenv("VLLM_ROCM_QUICK_REDUCE_CAST_BF16_TO_FP16", "True").lower()
         in ("true", "1")
     ),
+    # Two-level all-reduce for a TP group of 8 spanning two fully connected
+    # XGMI islands joined by PCIe (e.g. 8x MI210): hierarchical RCCL from
+    # HIER_MIN_BYTES (eager only), otherwise custom all-reduce inside the island
+    # then across GPU pairs below CUSTOM_MAX_BYTES (0 disables it). The 2.25 MiB
+    # defaults are the end-to-end break-even on 8x MI210, above the ~1 MiB
+    # crossover of the two paths in isolation.
+    "VLLM_ROCM_ISLAND_ALLREDUCE": lambda: (
+        os.getenv("VLLM_ROCM_ISLAND_ALLREDUCE", "True").lower() in ("true", "1")
+    ),
+    "VLLM_ROCM_ISLAND_AR_CUSTOM_MAX_BYTES": lambda: int(
+        os.getenv("VLLM_ROCM_ISLAND_AR_CUSTOM_MAX_BYTES", str(2304 * 1024))
+    ),
+    "VLLM_ROCM_ISLAND_AR_HIER_MIN_BYTES": lambda: int(
+        os.getenv("VLLM_ROCM_ISLAND_AR_HIER_MIN_BYTES", str(2304 * 1024))
+    ),
     # Custom quick allreduce kernel for MI3* cards.
     # Controls the maximum allowed number of data bytes(MB) for custom quick
     # allreduce communication.
